evidenceSource.scannerCasingPolicy: Observed scanner labels are transcribed literally in uppercase presentation; case-only differences from the official standalone components count as scanner-presentation matches.
evidenceSource.limitations: Eight fully visible rendered labels cover all three modeled shapes across seven unique fauna on Jemison and Codos. The set is sufficient for provisional acceptance but does not sample every fauna family, component, or Polish grammatical gender/number context.
